text:
riley (PM): morning crew 1 dropping a compact mock for the Alerting -> SLO panel. two big asks: 1) make notification preview space-efficient, 2) replace 'suppression' copy with something less ambiguous, 3) keyboard-first flow for expanding recipients. figma: https://figma.redwood/alerts/compact-ux
morgan (Design): thanks. main idea: inline channel strip that shows up to 2 avatars + a small "+N" chip. clicking +N opens an overlay (absolute positioned) with full list and per-channel actions (simulate, mute). overlay should not push layout.
dev (Frontend): implementation notes: use an svg-sprite fallback for avatars, then fetch full images asynchronously. debounce preview rendering (300-400ms) to protect the preview microservice. we'll also lazy-render the overlay on first open to keep initial DOM light.
morgan (Design): copy swap: use "Silences" (noun) and the toggle label "Silence notifications". helper microcopy: "Silences stop outgoing notifications but keep the alert in the audit trail." this clarifies it isn't a 'close' or 'snooze' exactly.
ana (A11y): small correction: my name is ana ;) accessibility asks: 1) the +N trigger must be a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. 2) overlay should use role=listbox with role=option items or role=menu/menuitem semantics? i prefer listbox if it's a selection list, menu for actions. since we have per-item actions, menu might be better. 3) ensure roving tabindex for arrow-key navigation and visible focus ring (not color-only).
dev (Frontend): good point. we'll implement overlay as role=menu with menuitems. roving tabindex + Enter to open per-item actions (simulate). ESC closes overlay and returns focus to +N button. also add aria-describedby on the overlay for a short description string.
morgan (Design): visual treatment: +N chip shows "+3" with an accessible tooltip "Show 3 more channels". when overlay opens show small icons (email, slack, pd) next to each destination, and a tiny "simulate" link that opens a modal with a delivery preview.
nana (A11y): simulate modal must be role=dialog, aria-modal=true, focus trapped, initial focus on the modal close button for screen readers to find it quickly. also provide an aria-live polite region in the panel that updates: e.g., "Preview updated: will notify 2 channels" when presets or recipients change. avoids surprises for screen reader users.
dev (Frontend): sample simulate payload for mockups:
```
{
  "alert_id": "AL-2026-79",
  "severity": "critical",
  "threshold": "p95>1.4s",
  "destinations": ["#backend", "pager:team-x"],
  "message": "High tail latency impacting inference endpoints"
}
```
morgan (Design): good sample. UX tweak: when user edits a preset and turns it into a custom value show an inline undo affordance: small text "Using custom value 1 Undo" that lives near the input for 6 seconds and is keyboard-focusable. also show a tiny "custom" badge on the preset chip so users see it's been overridden.
riley (PM): product wants the API to persist both values: send both `preset_choice` and `manual_threshold` so we can surface the source in downstream tooling. dev: can you coordinate with backend?
dev (Frontend): yes. plan to wire to API fields `preset_choice` (string) and `manual_threshold` (string|null). we'll post the exact contract to the api channel. also note: timeline preview is heavy to compute server-side so we'll ship a static illustrative timeline graphic with a muted badge "Live timeline (alpha)" instead of real-time data for now.
nana (A11y): keyboard flow for thresholds: Tab to preset chips, arrow keys to move, Enter toggles Custom editor. when Custom opens focus jumps to the first input and aria-live says "editing custom threshold". undo toast must be keyboard-focusable and dismissible via Escape. colors: chips must meet 4.5:1 contrast; focus ring should be at least 3px.
morgan (Design): CSS tokens we'll use: `--badge-bg`, `--badge-fg`, `--focus-ring`. example focus rule:
```
.channel-item:focus {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring);
  outline: none;
}
```
preview-bot: snapshot ready: https://images.redwood/preview/1779345678-01.png :camera_with_flash:
riley (PM): shipping checklist before the design review on Friday:
- [ ] compact channel strip + +N overlay (morgan + dev)
- [ ] simulate modal + sample payload (dev)
- [ ] rename "suppression" -> "Silences" + helper copy (morgan)
- [ ] preset vs custom badge + inline undo (morgan + dev)
- [ ] aria-live updates + menu semantics (ana)
- [ ] static timeline + live badge (dev)

morgan (Design): will push updated figma and tag preview-bot for diffs. ana please flag anything else once you run keyboard + screenreader pass.
nana (A11y): will run NVDA and VoiceOver checks and post any issues. remember to test with prefers-reduced-motion and high-contrast modes.
dev (Frontend): noted. I'll open a PR with the overlay skeleton and stubbed simulate modal so design review has something clickable.
riley (PM): great work team. post any late blockers here. :thumbsup:
